data.body_html:
Imagine gliding across the Mediterranean as the sun sinks behind La Concha, a glass of chilled Albariño in hand and a plate of jamón ibérico beside you. That’s the essence of a sunset tapas and wine pairing cruise Marbella – a private, unhurried evening on the water that turns a simple boat ride into a romantic memory. Departing from Puerto Banús, this experience is designed for couples who want quality time, great food, and a front-row seat to one of the Costa del Sol’s best shows: sunset over the sea.

Why choose a sunset tapas and wine pairing cruise Marbella?

A standard boat charter gives you the sea and the sky. This experience adds curated Spanish flavours, a dedicated skipper, and zero logistics. You don’t queue for a restaurant table, you don’t fight for a view – you arrive at the best seat in the house by water. The combination of tapas and local wines, paired with the golden light of dusk, creates a setting that’s hard to replicate on land. Whether it’s a proposal, an anniversary, or just a quiet escape, this cruise delivers intimacy without compromise.

Which boats sail this experience?

We offer two vessels for the sunset tapas and wine pairing cruise Marbella, both departing from Puerto Banús:

  • Astondoa 40 – 12.5 metres, up to 9 guests. A sleek, modern flybridge cruiser with a spacious aft deck perfect for dining al fresco.
  • Azimut 39 – 12.5 metres, up to 11 guests. An Italian-designed motor yacht with a comfortable saloon and generous sun pad area.

Both boats come with a licensed skipper, full insurance, fuel, and a sound system. The table is set for your tapas and wine pairing – just bring your appetite.

What’s included in the sunset tapas and wine pairing cruise Marbella?

Every charter includes:

  • Licensed skipper (English and Spanish speaking)
  • Fuel for the entire trip
  • Selection of Spanish tapas (jamón ibérico, manchego, patatas bravas, olives, bread with tomato)
  • Wine pairing: two glasses of local red, white, or cava per person (or soft drinks/beer if preferred)
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, and cava throughout
  • Light snacks (nuts, crackers)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%) – no hidden taxes

You can upgrade to a premium wine flight or request a custom tapas menu via WhatsApp before departure. We also cater to dietary restrictions – just let us know.

Pricing for the sunset tapas and wine pairing cruise Marbella

Prices are for the whole boat – not per person. The 2-hour option is ideal for a quick sunset toast, while the 4-hour charter lets you cruise along the coast to Cabopino or even Estepona. The 6- and 8-hour options include more sailing time and can be combined with a swim stop if the weather allows.

What to expect on the evening

Your cruise departs from Puerto Banús, usually 1.5 to 2 hours before sunset. The skipper will navigate along the Marbella coastline, passing the Golden Mile, the Marbella Marina, and the cliffs of Cala del Faro. As the sun dips, the sky turns shades of orange and pink – the perfect backdrop for your tapas and wine. You’ll have time to relax on deck, take photos, and simply enjoy the quiet hum of the boat. No rush, no crowds.

How to book your sunset tapas and wine pairing cruise Marbella

All bookings are handled via WhatsApp. Just send us your preferred date, group size, and any special requests (proposal setup, dietary needs, extra wine). We’ll confirm availability and send you the details. Payment is secure and straightforward. Browse all our Marbella boat charters for more options, or go directly to the sunset experience.
